title: Open meadow
description: A clear 120 m meadow with daylight. Start with space and build anything.

title: Village street
description: A tree-lined neighborhood with walking residents and a car driving down the street.

title: Forest clearing
description: A quiet clearing surrounded by trees, rocks, and benches. Practice scale and placement.

title: Physics playground
description: Knock over stacked crates and dominoes. Press Play, then walk into props in first person.

title: Sculpture gallery
description: A walkable exhibition of primitive shapes. Experiment with composition, color, and scale.

title: Night plaza
description: A plaza after dark. Balance ambient light, warm lamps, and a colored centerpiece.

title: Driving avenue
description: Two cars on repeating routes. Adjust speeds, delays, and distances in the inspector.

title: Adventure course
description: Walk through arches and around obstacles. Test movement, collisions, and viewpoints.

title: Park study
description: The original park, with paths, trees, props, and room to expand.
